Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud Marketplace + SI architecture sync and joint workshop

Hi Jin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. CloudBridge and Redwood have a strong fit for the marketplace listing + our SI partner program — the next step I suggested internally was a short architecture review followed by a hands-on integration workshop where we align on deployment topology, lead time for marketplace listing, and operational responsibilities.

Proposed session plan (60-90 min):
- 15 min: Introductions and scope (who owns what in the joint offering)
- 25 min: Architecture deep-dive (networking, KMS, data flow, telemetry)
- 15 min: Marketplace packaging checklist and required artifacts
- 15 min: Action items and mutual action plan (owners + timelines)

Attached: proposed-agenda.pdf and a high-level redwood-infra-diagram.png to give your cloud architects a head start.

Availability from our side: Thu Mar 26 10:00-12:00 PT or Fri Mar 27 14:00-16:00 PT. If neither works, please share 2x slots that suit Lydia and your solutions team.

Sergio, Vanessa — can you join the architecture portion? Vanessa, please flag any marketplace items we must prepare ahead.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Sr. Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
